resources.string: This phone can\'t use the USB fallback here. Contact IT or connect to a supported Wi-Fi network.
Turn on Developer options under Settings, About phone: tap Build number seven times.
Open Wireless debugging and choose Pair device with pairing code. Android shows a six-digit code and a port: read them to the developer, who enters them on the desktop. Setu never asks for that code.
Hosting still works without them, but you won\'t see its status.
1. Connect USB to a trusted computer.
2. Allow USB debugging on the phone.
3. On the computer, run adb tcpip 5555.
4. Keep the cable connected until Setu confirms.
Don\'t unplug yet: waiting for the phone to report 127.0.0.1:5555.
Setup confirmed. You can unplug the USB cable.
Use only trusted networks. Don\'t forward port 5555.
Setu is exempt from battery optimisation.
Setu is optimised; the system may stop it in the background.
The battery state could not be read.
Some phone makers add extra switches we can\'t check. Turn off restrictions for Setu if you see them.
Install failed on a Xiaomi phone?
If installing shows INSTALL_FAILED_USER_RESTRICTED, turn on Install via USB and USB debugging (Security settings) in Developer options, where IT allows it.
